description.value: Britannia Shipyards National Historic Site is a free, eight-acre outdoor heritage site on the banks of the Fraser River in Steveston, showcasing the oldest shipyard community in British Columbia through preserved heritage buildings arranged along a wooden boardwalk. The site brings BC's fishing, canning, and boatbuilding history to life through exhibits, programs, and an active wooden boat restoration project. Located just minutes from Steveston village, it is easily reached by bike and offers a scenic stop on a Fraser River cycling route.
